mentions.name: Fogpane
mentions.description: A simple app that opens a photo, covers it with a layer of fog, and lets the user wipe the fog away with a finger to reveal the image underneath, like drawing on a fogged-up window. It was released on the App Store as an experiment in letting AI (Codex) write essentially all of the code, with the author guiding it, testing, reporting bugs, and making product and design decisions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I just released a small app called Fogpane:
https://asok.github.io/fog-website/index.html?lang=en

The concept is intentionally simple: you open a photo, it gets covered by a layer of fog, and you use your finger to wipe the fog away and reveal the image underneath – a bit like drawing on a fogged-up window.
